nodes.label: DB::Put / DB::Write
nodes.desc: Public write entry point: user builds a WriteBatch and submits it to the DB.

nodes.label: DB::Get / GetImpl
nodes.desc: Point-read entry point: walks live memtables, immutable memtables, then the current Version's SST levels.

nodes.label: ColumnFamilyOptions / DBOptions
nodes.desc: Tuning surface: write buffer sizes, compaction style, WAL policy, block size, compression.

nodes.label: DBImpl::Write / WriteImpl
nodes.desc: Admits writers, batches concurrent writers under one leader, writes the WAL, then applies the batch to memtables.

nodes.label: Writer::AddRecord (WAL)
nodes.desc: CRC-framed append-only WAL records; the same Writer class also frames MANIFEST records.

nodes.label: MemTable::Add
nodes.desc: Encodes internal key/value pairs into the active memtable, which is backed by a concurrent skip list.

nodes.label: DBImpl::BackgroundCallFlush
nodes.desc: Background flush thread entry point: hands immutable memtables to a flush job.

nodes.label: FlushJob::Run
nodes.desc: Streams memtable entries into a new L0 SST file and records sequence-number boundaries.

nodes.label: BlockBasedTableBuilder
nodes.desc: Writes sorted key/value runs into block-based SST files with data blocks, index blocks, and filter blocks.

nodes.label: DBImpl::BackgroundCallCompaction
nodes.desc: Background compaction thread entry point: picks and executes level compactions continuously.

nodes.label: CompactionJob::Run
nodes.desc: Merges overlapping runs into lower levels, dropping shadowed, deleted, and expired entries.

nodes.label: VersionSet::LogAndApply
nodes.desc: Single serialized install point for new Versions; appends VersionEdits to the MANIFEST.
